notes: Continue Watching works like Nuvio's: one card per show, and when you finish an episode the next one waits there as Up next (New episode when it just came out). 90% in counts as watched. Hold a card for Mark as watched. Closed the app in the middle of something? It offers it back when you return. A content advisory (Violence · Severe …) shows for a few seconds as a title starts (Settings › Playback).
